body_markdown:
# Ex. dividend first quarter 2026


13 August 2026 07:51 (CEST)


Last modified


14 August 2026 12:32


The shares in Equinor ASA will be traded on the Oslo Stock Exchange (OSE) and New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) exclusive the first quarter 2026 cash dividend as detailed below.


Ex. date OSE: 13 August 2026


Ex. date NYSE: 14 August 2026


Dividend amount: 0.39


Announced currency: USD


*This information is published in accordance with the requirements of the Continuing Obligations and is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to Section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.*


## Latest news


- [13 October 2026 Equinor and Eneco sign five-year gas agreement with verified emissions data Equinor and Dutch energy company Eneco have signed a five-year agreement for natural gas deliveries. The covers around 9 TWh of natural gas per year, or approximately 0.9 billion cubic metres, to the Dutch gas grid with deliveries started on 1 October 2026.](https://www.equinor.com/news/20261013-eneco-five-year-gas-agreement)
- [9 October 2026 Equinor and Shell partner on the Bay du Nord project Equinor and Shell have signed an agreement under which Shell will acquire a 30% interest in the Bay du Nord project offshore Newfoundland and Labrador in Canada. The transaction supports the continued maturation of Bay du Nord towards an investment decision currently targeted for early 2027.](https://www.equinor.com/news/20261009-equinor-and-shell-partner-on-bay-du-nord)
- [8 October 2026 Gas discovery at the Gullfaks field in the North Sea Equinor and its partners have discovered gas at the Gullfaks South field, 190 kilometres northwest of Bergen.](https://www.equinor.com/news/20261008-gas-discovery-gullfaks-field)
